entities.name: Aether Spire
entities.description: Central aether collection tower and administrative heart of Ghirapur.

entities.name: Consulate

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Planeswalker who used the Spire as a secret base and built the Planar Bridge.

entities.name: Planar Bridge
entities.description: Machine built from Rashmi's space-folding device to send objects through the Blind Eternities.

entities.name: Rashmi
entities.description: Inventor whose space-folding device Tezzeret repurposed.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: Planeswalker alliance who helped cut off Tezzeret's aether.

entities.description: Planeswalker who tried to assassinate Tezzeret.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar

events.summary: Tezzeret made the Spire his secret base, converting Rashmi's device into the Planar Bridge, powered by aether from the Aether Hub.
events.quote: the Aether Spire in Ghirapur became the secret base of operations for Tezzeret.

events.summary: The renegades and the Gatewatch cut off Tezzeret's aether; seizure of the Aether Hub failed to permanently disrupt him.
events.quote: After an initial seizure of the Aether Hub failed to permanently disrupt Tezzeret's access

events.summary: The renegades assaulted the Aether Spire with the Heart of Kiran and a fleet.
events.quote: the renegades staged a direct assault on the Aether Spire itself.

events.summary: Liliana tried to assassinate Tezzeret while Chandra and Gideon destroyed the Planar Bridge.
events.quote: Liliana Vess attempted to assassinate Tezzeret inside the Spire

events.summary: Tezzeret escaped by implanting the Bridge's core into himself and planeswalking away.
events.quote: Tezzeret escaped by implanting its core into himself and planeswalking away

relations.quote: Liliana Vess attempted to assassinate Tezzeret inside the Spire

relations.note: Moved to cut off his aether
relations.quote: they launched operations to cut off his aether supply
